<strand Suspended /> Combatants cannot move, shoot, or use abilities. Duration depends on <link Enemy Rank [#CombatantClassifications] />:
• Rank-and-File and Elite enemies: up to 6 seconds
• Minibosses: up to 3 seconds
• Bosses: 1 second

Bosses remain unimpeded and take <pve 300 /> <pvp [?] /> <strand Strand /> damage instead. They still count as <strand Suspended /> during the brief debuff before breaking free.

<strand Suspended /> Players are lifted into the air for 2 seconds. They can slowly hover horizontally and Hip-fire their weapons in third person.

<unstoppable/>Unstoppable Champions are stunned by <strand Suspend />.

// The source lists durations of 6+2 seconds for Rank-and-File/Elites, 3+1 for Minibosses, and 2+1 for Players without identifying the bonus condition. Base durations remain in the draft; the unidentified bonuses are preserved here.

source.text:
Suspended Combatants are unable to move, shoot, or use abilities.
Rank-and-File and Elite Combatants are suspended for up to 6+2 seconds. Minibosses are only suspended for up to 3+1 seconds.
Boss Combatants are unimpeded by suspension's effects, snapping out of them after 1 second, receiving instead 300 Strand Damage.
Boss Combatants still count as being afflicted by the Suspend debuff during its brief duration despite not receiving its effects.

Suspended Guardians are lifted midair, being able to slowly hover horizontally and hipfire their weapons for 2+1 seconds in a third-person perspective.

Unstoppable Champions are stunned upon being Suspended.
